content:
Overview

Guadalajara is a city in Jalisco with a population of 5,268,642. Mexico’s second city, known for tequila, mariachi, and a booming tech and creative scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
